nodes.subtitle: BanditRLProof.Algorithms.ThompsonAlgorithmDensity
nodes.description: This module isolates the measure-theoretic core of LML's algorithm-density posterior transport. nodes.label: comp_withDensity_history

nodes.description: Composing a kernel weighted by a density independent of its input is the same as weighting the composed output measure.
